assertions: Every candidate container observed 1000 CPU millis and 1073741824 memory bytes.
Every separate verifier container observed 1000 CPU millis and 268435456 memory bytes.
Each task reserved 2000 CPU millis, 1342177280 memory bytes and 2 container slots.
Independent marker values survived concurrent writes to identical in-container paths.
Sealed output manifests, run directories and container identities were distinct.
Completed materialized workspaces were removed; prior sealed artifacts retained identical hashes.

interruption.stage: Gear concurrent worker observation before one C2 eval was submitted
interruption.fix: Gear serializes fresh worker observations per Hitch root and retries only the exact structured busy response within the original deadline. Eval submissions are not retried by this mechanism.
interruption.resume_reason: The complete resident environment binding differed after restarting the canary process. The original operation was rejected before submission; its identity was not bypassed.
interruption.test_command_correction: The first native invocation omitted --daemon and was rejected before starting any trial. The corrected invocation is recorded; prior trials were not rerun.

limitations: This uses a deterministic no-API agent and synthetic data; it does not estimate Titanic model quality.
A 30-second in-sandbox hold makes active experiment overlap observable; it is not a training throughput measurement.
The interrupted operation remains retained with one completed slot and one never-submitted slot; no successful real resume is claimed.
Same-task parallelism is enabled only for the supported, host-verified local Docker isolation contract.
